design_description: A black and electric-purple jersey built around a bold geometric pattern. Wide vertical black panels create the main structure, while vivid purple sections use layered chevrons, fractured shapes and subtle cracked textures for depth. The pattern continues across the shoulders and sleeves, giving the shirt a consistent all-over graphic identity. Thin purple lines and matching purple collar and cuff details sharpen the darker areas. Overall, it's a high-contrast, aggressive modern design, combining strong vertical structure with angular purple graphics and textured detailing.
